summary: TELUS Corporation filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer report) incorporating by reference the results of its annual general meeting held May 8, 2026. Standard matters voted on included election of 14 directors (each with >95% support), appointment of Deloitte LLP as auditors (92.18% for), advisory approval of executive compensation (88.82% for), and an increase to the share reserve under the RSU Plan (95.34% for). No takeover, special distribution, structural change, or unusual item is present. This is a routine AGM voting report with no special-situation elements, so the appropriate classification is None.
